ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-intensity white dominates approximately 90% of the visible surface area, with low-intensity dark gray/black confined to the periphery and distal tips.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central region consists of a single large contiguous high-intensity white field. Darker pigmentation is mapped as a continuous narrow band along the trailing edge and concentrated irregular clusters at the extreme left and right lobe terminals.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Small V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 65 degrees and a shallow depth relative to the fluke lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Frequent low-amplitude serrations present along the entire trailing edge boundary, manifesting as a series of rhythmic peaks and shallow valleys with a spacing of approximately 15-25 pixels.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical concave curve originating from the median notch and extending toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast dark pixel clusters located at both the left and right distal tips, indicating localized textural irregularities.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive dark, irregular protrusions at both distal tips consistent with epibiont colonization or barnacle clusters.
